integrity: The proof uses the weighted Euler and conormal sequences on the smooth hypersurface stack, line-bundle cohomology vanishing, the fact that a relation below the hypersurface degree lifts to the polynomial ring, and the Koszul description of first syzygies of the coordinate regular sequence. A finite verifier checks the weighted Euler-map calculation on all sorted weight quadruples up to 6 and on an explicit quasi-smooth Fermat example.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact first twist only for first-order reflexive differentials. It does not determine the corresponding threshold for higher symmetric powers, and it does not classify low-degree hypersurfaces for which the defining equation can enter the first syzygies.
title: The first twisted reflexive \(1\)-form occurs in degree \(a_0+a_1\)
